image_description: Three disposable lighters arranged side-by-side on a pink surface. The central lighter is red with a blue and black woven-pattern sleeve covering the fuel tank, topped with a clear plastic wind guard and metal hood. The left lighter is red with a graphic of a face and partial text 'IVE'. The right lighter is cream/yellow with red accents and a black rectangular window, featuring a small metal loop at the top.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Compact handheld device sized to fit comfortably within a closed palm.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The objects exhibit the standard proportions of disposable lighters (approx. 5-8cm height relative to width), consistent with handheld devices.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular or cylindrical body with hinged lid or fixed top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All three objects have rectangular bodies. The tops are fixed structures typical of disposable lighters (wind guards/hoods), not hinged flip-tops, which matches the 'fixed top' alternative in the checkpoint.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flame emerges from small metal tube at top when activated.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The lighters are not currently lit; no flame is visible. The nozzle structure is obscured by the wind guards/hoods.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flint wheel or piezoelectric button ignition mechanism.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The central lighter clearly shows the brown plastic actuator lever and spark mechanism assembly under the clear hood. The side lighters show similar top assemblies consistent with piezoelectric igniters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Fuel nozzle producing flame from internal reservoir.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The specific nozzle tip is hidden inside the metal wind guard/hood structure and cannot be visually confirmed without disassembly or activation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Hinged flip-top lid or fixed top with spark wheel.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The objects feature fixed tops with integrated spark mechanisms (piezoelectric levers/wheels), satisfying the 'fixed top' condition.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Metal or plastic casing with brushed chrome or colored enamel finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The casings appear to be plastic with printed graphics (red, cream) and one has a textured fabric/plastic sleeve. The hoods are metal. This matches the material description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Internal butane or lighter fluid reservoir.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The reservoir is internal and opaque (or obscured by the sleeve on the center lighter); the fuel itself is not directly visible.
The form factor and components confirm these are portable ignition devices.

artifact_observations.location: Left lighter face graphic and bottom-right corner watermark
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the left lighter ('IVE') appears cut off or nonsensical rather than a clear brand name. Additionally, there is a string of gibberish characters/symbols in the bottom right corner resembling a corrupted watermark or signature.
The woven pattern on the sleeve has a slightly repetitive, digitally generated texture that lacks the fine micro-detail of real fabric or knitted plastic, appearing somewhat 'painted on'.
The small metal loop at the top of the right lighter seems to merge slightly into the plastic casing without a clear attachment point or hinge mechanism, looking physically ambiguous.
